name: openclaw
description: The AI that really does things. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
one_liner: A personal AI assistant that lives on your own computer and can talk to you through apps you already use — Discord, WhatsApp, Slack, iMessage — and actually take actions, not just chat.
buyer: A solo entrepreneur or small team that wants an always-available assistant handling scheduling, replies, and small tasks across the chat apps they already use, without paying for a dozen separate SaaS bots.
business_use_cases: A small business owner has it monitor their WhatsApp Business account and draft replies to common customer questions while they're busy.
A freelancer sets it up in Slack to triage incoming client messages and flag urgent ones, acting as a lightweight virtual assistant.
A local agency resells 'personal AI assistant setup and hosting' as a productized service to non-technical small business owners.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid setup, hosting, and channel integration for non-technical users who want this running but can't self-host it.
Sell a managed subscription with uptime guarantees and pre-built task packs (scheduling, customer replies, reminders).

steal_this: This weekend, package a one-click hosted deployment (Docker + a simple onboarding wizard) targeted at small business owners who want an AI assistant in their existing WhatsApp number without touching a terminal.
